description:
Problem: `benchbox run` ignores `BENCHBOX_RESULTS_DIR` (it resolves the variable, creates the directory, then writes to `<benchmark_runs>/results`). The one-line fix is to resolve `DirectoryManager.results_dir` through `benchbox.core.runtime_paths.resolve_results_dir`. A review of that fix on 2026-11-23 found it is not safe alone: `export --last`, `submit --last`, `publish run --last`, `visualize` and `compare` look for results in the literal relative path `benchmark_runs/results` (benchbox/cli/commands/export.py, submit.py, publish.py, visualize.py, compare.py, benchbox/core/visualization/result_plotter.py). After the redirect a follow-up command could pick an older run from that path or find nothing. Those lookups are also wrong today for the default root, which is `<checkout-parent>/benchmark_runs`, and for `BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR`.

Expected outcome: the run command and every 'latest result' lookup use one resolver, so a result written by `benchbox run` is the one `--last` finds, with or without the variables set.

A tested implementation of the run-side change exists on branch `feat/shared-data-lifecycle--results-dir-env-ignored-by-cli-run-20261122` at commit c725f39add (benchbox/cli/config.py, tests/unit/cli/test_run_results_dir.py, AGENTS.md wording).
